name: DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.newFrontM_val
typeText:
∀ {ν : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} ν] (N : DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network ν) (c : ν → Nat)
  (U : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} ν ν)) (seen front : List.{0} ν),
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Costed.val (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.newFrontM N c U seen front))
    (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.newFront N U seen front)

source.code:
theorem newFrontM_val (U : List (ν × ν)) (seen front : List ν) :
    (N.newFrontM c U seen front).val = N.newFront U seen front := by
  unfold newFrontM newFront
  rw [filterM_val 1 _ (fun y => decide (y ∉ seen ∧ y ∉ front ∧ front.any (fun x => decide (N.ResL U x y))))]
  intro y
  simp only [bind_val, memNM_val, pure_val]
  rw [anyM_val 1 _ (fun x => decide (N.ResL U x y)) (fun x => N.resM_val c U x y)]
  apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
  simp [and_assoc]
